messages:
Priya Patel: Quick announcement for folks working with Dedicated/Private deployments — were launching a short role-based micro-course called 'Handling Sensitive Deployments'. Required for engineers, SREs, oncall who touch customer environments. Completion deadline: 14 days from today (2026-04-06). Please prioritize if youre in the infra/onboarding flow.

Alex Chen: thanks — where's the course? link?

Priya Patel: Learning Hub link: https://go/redwood/learning/sensitive-deploy (course + 10-question quiz). Estimated time 20-30 mins. After passing, upload certificate to the evidence folder: https://redwood.share/evidence/microcerts and tick the tracker.

Samira Gomez: Is this separate from the annual privacy module or counts towards SOC2 evidence?

Priya Patel: Separate module focused on operational controls for Dedicated/Private: network boundaries, key handling, secret rotation, access reviews. It feeds into our SOC2 evidence bundle for the upcoming audit — so we need the uploads. If you completed 'SOC2 Ops Fundamentals' in last 12 months, you can file an exemption form instead: https://go/redwood/forms/microcert-exemption.

Ben Rivers: Contractors with infra access — do they need to do it?

Priya Patel: Yes if they have access to customer environments. Managers must track contractor completion or request an exemption with contractor details. Manager digest will be sent next week.

Alex Chen: Does it include KMS/HSM guidance or just network controls?

Priya Patel: Both. There's a short KMS/HSM primer and a checklist for key rotation and role-based access. Two quiz questions cover key handling.

Samira Gomez: Can someone export a CSV of completions? I need to sync with rollout lists.

Training Bot: Training Bot: Course 'Handling Sensitive Deployments' created. Enrollment open. Use `/training status sensitive-deploy` to fetch live completion counts.

Priya Patel: I will export a CSV and post to #eng-oncall by EOD tomorrow. Managers will get a reminder digest listing direct reports who haven't completed.

Ben Rivers: New hires auto-enrolled?

Priya Patel: Yes, it will be added to the new-hire checklist for affected roles starting next week. If you need an accommodation, DM me. :slightly_smiling_face:

Alex Chen: Doing it after stand.

Training Bot: Training Bot: Alex Chen marked COMPLETE for 'Handling Sensitive Deployments' (quiz 9/10).

Priya Patel: Thanks Alex. Everyone please finish within the window so we can close the evidence bundle for audit. Ping me with any access issues.
